Fall Quarter, 2026

School of Humanities

School of Humanities comments:

DROP: The deadline to drop courses in the School of Humanities is Friday of Week 2 by 5:00PM. Drops can be made in WebReg.

CHANGE: The deadline to change the grading option or variable units is Friday of Week 2 by 5:00PM. Changes can be made in WebReg. From Weeks 3 through 10, requests for changes to the grading option can be made through StudentAccess.

ADD: The deadline to add courses in the School of Humanities is Friday of Week 2 by 5:00PM. Adds can be made in WebReg.

SCHOOL & MAJOR COURSES: All courses taken to fulfill school or major requirements must be completed for letter grades.

Any exception to the add or drop deadline must be requested as an Enrollment Exception through StudentAccess. Approval is not guaranteed. For more information on Humanities policies regarding adding and dropping a course, visit http://www.humanities.uci.edu/undergrad/students/add_drop.php

For more information on Humanities policies on changing the grade grading option, visit http://www.humanities.uci.edu/undergrad/changes-grading-option

Helpful scheduling resources for Humanities students:

Humanities Course Descriptions: http://hq.humanities.uci.edu/undergrad/academics/courses.php

Humanities Planned Course Schedules: http://www.humanities.uci.edu/undergrad/academics/planned
